groups.name: workflow.services
groups.description: External service endpoints used by workflow execution.

properties.name: spring.link-datasource.driver-class-name
properties.description: Fully qualified name of the JDBC driver for the Link datasource.

properties.name: spring.link-datasource.url
properties.description: JDBC URL of the Link datasource.

properties.name: spring.link-datasource.username
properties.description: Login username of the Link datasource.

properties.name: spring.link-datasource.password
properties.description: Login password of the Link datasource.

properties.name: spring.link-datasource.hikari.maximum-pool-size
properties.description: Maximum size of the Link datasource HikariCP pool.

properties.name: spring.link-datasource.hikari.minimum-idle
properties.description: Minimum number of idle connections maintained by the Link datasource HikariCP pool.

properties.name: spring.link-datasource.hikari.connection-timeout
properties.description: Maximum number of milliseconds that a client will wait for a Link datasource connection.

properties.name: spring.link-datasource.hikari.idle-timeout
properties.description: Maximum amount of time in milliseconds that a Link datasource connection is allowed to sit idle.

properties.name: spring.link-datasource.hikari.max-lifetime
properties.description: Maximum lifetime in milliseconds of a Link datasource connection in the pool.

properties.name: spring.link-datasource.hikari.connection-test-query
properties.description: SQL query used to test Link datasource connections.

properties.name: spring.link-datasource.hikari.validation-timeout
properties.description: Maximum amount of time in milliseconds that Link datasource connection validation can take.

properties.name: workflow.services.aitools-url
properties.description: AI tools or Link service base URL.

properties.name: workflow.services.python-workflow-url
properties.description: Python workflow service base URL used for comparison or compatibility.
